notes.title: IMPORTANT LEADERBOARD UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h3]Important Information:[/h3]
The Leaderboard display calls have been fixed (not so much a bug as a 'typo'). The original error resulted in the total time being incorrectly displayed both in-game and on Steam. This has now been fixed, but the leaderboards had to be wiped to remove the erroneous entries.

[b]Your individual level times and scores are unaffected[/b] - they are stored separately from the overall display.

To add your times back to the global leaderboards you simply need to launch the game, and the overall values will be recalculated and updated for correct display.
Speaking of display, times are now shown as '[i]hrs : mins : secs . millisecs[/i]', instead of just seconds, as was the case before.

If your score does not automatically appear on the leaderboard (and you've finished the game, so it should be there), try toggling the 'Highest Scores' / 'Fastest Times' switch. This will force an update and everything should be good to go.

[i]Apologies for the inconvenience, but it was an important point.[/i]

[h3]Additional Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The camera tracking has been reworked, and smoothed considerably. Movement is now less jarring.
[*] The Lighting has undergone a bit of a 'tweak'. Not hugely noticeable, but still an improvement.
[*] A few general performance issues addressed.
[/list]

[h3]Removal of the Demo[/h3]
[b]PLOT![/b] has been out for a few weeks now, and the demo was intended purely as a pre-release feature. So I've taken the decision to remove the demo. Sorry to the people that this impacts.

If you have any issues or questions regarding this update please let me know.

Until the next one...

Danny
(allnodcoms)
